title.value: Bodleian Visiting Fellowships in Special Collections
title.evidence_quote: Bodleian Visiting Fellowships in Special Collections

field: Research using the Bodleian special collections
qualifications: Open to academically affiliated and independent scholars at any postdoctoral level
Current doctoral students must have submitted their thesis before the deadline and been awarded the doctorate before taking up the fellowship
Applications by email to fellowships@bodleian.ox.ac.uk with the online application form, before 5pm GMT on 27 November 2026
Fellowship year runs 1 August to 31 July
description_short: The Bodleian Libraries offer Visiting Fellowships in Special Collections for 2027-28, open to affiliated and independent scholars at any postdoctoral level. Applications go by email and close 27 November 2026 at 5pm GMT; the fellowship year runs August to July.
